headline: Singapore Refined Oil Product Inventories Drop to Three-Week Low
summary: Official inventory data showed Singapore commercial stockpiles of refined oil products decreased to a three-week low, driven by a draw across light and middle distillate inventories.
why: Singapore is the main pricing and storage hub for refined petroleum products in the Asia-Pacific region.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Declining distillate stockpiles in a primary transit hub signal tighter physical product supplies.
